items.item:
6. A new version of an owner-activated flow with a `state-transition` node,
   differing only in one constant, is not active, and no approval or standing
   grant of the earlier version applies to it.
   [witness: verification:kernel_a06_new_version_inherits_nothing]
statements:
```text
flow_activation -> proven(flow_version) at activation
highest_effect_class = read  -> activated_by = kernel
highest_effect_class > read  -> activated_by = owner
agent_asks(effectful) -> refused AND nothing_kept
new_flow_version -/> inherits(activation | grant | approval)
```

verdicts.item:
6. A new version of an owner-activated flow with a `state-transition` node,
   differing only in one constant, is not active, and no approval or standing
   grant of the earlier version applies to it.
   [witness: verification:kernel_a06_new_version_inherits_nothing]
statements:
```text
flow_activation -> proven(flow_version) at activation
highest_effect_class = read  -> activated_by = kernel
highest_effect_class > read  -> activated_by = owner
agent_asks(effectful) -> refused AND nothing_kept
new_flow_version -/> inherits(activation | grant | approval)
```
verdicts.why: The check asserts that the proven state-transition version initially remains inactive and inherits neither the earlier standing grant nor approval, and that its draft-write authority comes from its own activation. It does not test read-only kernel activation, refusal and nothing-kept for an effectful agent request, or that activation itself reproves the version; owner activation is exercised but owner exclusivity is not asserted.
